svg.title: WA4 control and lid receiving: hardware, wiring, printed fixtures and MQTT events
svg.desc: Top-down schematic of table T1, 70 by 46 centimetres. Management computer, network scale with receiving tray and lid, XIAO camera and privacy hood, optional scanner and three-button console connect to an under-table Raspberry Pi and private network. Shared roof photovoltaics, Growatt inverter and battery BMS require an approved read-only adapter. Solid wires show planned supported connection types; dashed amber links require interface selection or commissioning. Printed fixture quantities, current Python implementation, all fifteen exact MQTT activity suffixes, candidate and commissioned prefixes, diagnostic topic and local-outbox default are included. Equipment placement is exploded for readability and does not establish physical fit or electrical terminal pinouts.
svg.text: IN Munich lid + energy state → verified lid + record
